title: Binance halts withdrawals after record hack; digital assets, crypto stocks slump
full_text:
Investing.com - Binance suspended withdrawals on Friday after hackers stole $6.3 billion from the cryptocurrency exchange in the biggest heist in the history of the digital asset industry. Get more breaking news on Bitcoin and the crypto industry by subscribing to InvestingPro
In a statement, the exchange said it was working with partners to freeze about $3 billion in affected assets and stressed that "user funds were safe." Binance will also cover all losses from its funds.
Withdrawals will remain temporarily suspended until security checks are completed, Binance said. The company expects to resume withdrawals by Sunday.
The exchange said that the incident stemmed from a compromised development and operations engineer’s laptop, which allowed an attacker to carry out unauthorized withdrawals. There was no evidence of any wallet private key leak.
Citing U.S. blockchain analysis groups TRM Labs and Chainalysis, Reuters reported that the majority of heist took place over 20 minutes starting late on Thursday, with the hackers appearing to have exploited Binance’s transaction authorization procedures. Both firms said they were confident that North Korea’s "elite hacking unit," known as TraderTraitor, was likely behind the cyberattack.
Glassnode data showed $1.66 billion in stablecoin USDT, $1.45 billion in Bitcoin, and $767 million in stablecoin USDC were drained from the exchange. Ether and several other smaller altcoins were also siphoned from the exchange.
Separately, USDC operator Circle said it had frozen over 800 million USDC associated with the hack, while stablecoin grouop Tether said it froze over 1.567 billion USDT associated with the hack.
Bitcoin fell following news of the hack, extending losses from earlier this week. The world’s largest token was last down by 3.2% to $77,484.1, after initially dropping to as low as $76,518. Ether fell 3.7% to $2,235.94.
Binance’s native BNB token pared initial losses to trade down 5.5%. Glassnode said the exchange’s balance of BNB was "left untouched."
Losses spilled over into crypto stocks, with U.S. exchange Coinbase (NASDAQ:COIN) and Bitcoin treasury Strategy (NASDAQ:MSTR) falling more than 5% in premarket trading Friday. Robinhood shares also tumbled 6.3%.
(Vahid Karaahmetovic and Scott Kanowsky contributed to this report.)

title: Intel plummets over 28% as weak forecast overshadows earnings beat
full_text:
Investing.com — Intel (NASDAQ: INTC) shares shed more than a fourth of their value in U.S. trading on Friday morning, after the chipmaker forecast fourth-quarter earnings and revenue well below Wall Street expectations.
Third-quarter adjusted earnings came in at $0.52 per share, beating analyst estimates of $0.40. Revenue rose 21% year over year to $16.5 billion, slightly above consensus of $16.48 billion.
The outlook was considerably weaker. Intel forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $15 billion to $16 billion, below analyst expectations of $17.08 billion. At the midpoint, the range implies a shortfall of about 9%. Adjusted earnings are expected to reach $0.25 per share, compared with consensus of $0.44.
The guidance comes as Intel faces contrasting trends across its businesses, with strong demand for server CPUs helping offset weakness in the PC market.
“Despite near-term headwinds across the PC industry, demand for our CPUs remains robust,” Chief Executive Lip-Bu Tan said, adding that the results reflected improving execution, expanded supply and progress in process technology.
Chief Financial Officer David Zinsner said Intel expects PC market weakness to continue through at least the first half of next year.
Revenue from Intel’s Client Computing and Physical AI Group fell 5% year over year to $8.1 billion in the third quarter, reflecting the industry slowdown. By contrast, revenue from its Data Center and AI segment surged 78% to $7.3 billion, marking the strongest data-center revenue growth in 15 years, according to Zinsner.
Intel’s profitability outlook also disappointed. Adjusted gross margin expanded to 44.1% in the third quarter from 40% a year earlier, but the company expects the metric to decline to 38% in the fourth quarter.
"Client easy comps will not materialize until 2H27, while we continue to model share loss in both segments in 2027," Baird analysts said in a client note.
Intel Foundry revenue increased 58% year over year to $6.7 billion. The company generated $5.1 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter, while investors continue to assess whether its manufacturing business can attract enough external customers to support its long-term investment plans.
(Scott Kanowsky contributed reporting)

title: Amazon shares drop as holiday forecast misses Wall Street targets
full_text:
Investing.com -- Amazon missed quarterly financial estimates, while the e-commerce and tech giant’s negative free cash flow ballooned amid elevated spending on artificial intelligence.
Shares of the company were down more than 4% in early U.S. trading on Friday
The Seattle, Washington-based firm’s results come at a time when AI spending has been under intense scrutiny. Concerns have soared over the billions of dollars being poured into AI infrastructure, or the combined hardware and software stack needed to handle massive data and computing power used to build and train AI processes.
Worries have also increased about the huge amounts of debt being issued by companies to fund these AI infrastructure buildouts, which in turn has contributed to a sell-off in government debt in the U.S. and across the world.
Amazon said free cash flow was negative $42.4 billion for the trailing twelve months, driven primarily by a Y/Y increase of $94.8 billion in purchases of property and equipment, mainly reflecting investments in AI.
Amazon, through its market-leading cloud unit Amazon Web Services (AWS), has become a major AI player and a so-called hyperscaler, investing heavily in building and operating large-scale data centers. Other AI hyperscalers include Meta Platforms, Microsoft, Alphabet, and Oracle.
"We believe mgmt continues to earn the right to invest despite the negative NT FCF impact as these investments are becoming increasingly de-risked," analysts at Truist said, while adding that the AMZN stock remains "one of the best plays on the secular growth of AI/Cloud, eCom, and Ads, all at a compelling valuation."
The world’s fifth-largest publicly listed firm said AWS revenue was $45.98 billion in Q3 2026, a surge of 39.3% Y/Y and marking the fastest growth in nearly five years.
“Our AWS investment in functionality and infrastructure is working, with over 39% year-over-year revenue growth in Q3 ($184 billion revenue run rate) and projected revenue growth rates of over 40% both in 2027 and in 2028,” AMZN top boss Andy Jassy said in a statement.
Amazon has also gained a notable foothold in the AI industry through its multi-billion dollar investments in leading AI frontier lab Anthropic. The Claude-developer unveiled its initial public offering filing earlier this week, and is targeting what could become the biggest market debut in history.
Looking at Amazon’s overall results, it earned $1.89 per share on revenue of $201.94 billion for its Q3 2026. Analysts had expected a profit of $1.96 per share on revenue of $202.10 billion.
The bottom-line was hit by pre-tax gains of $9.5 billion in Q3 2025 that was included in non-operating income (expense) from Amazon’s investments in Anthropic. Meanwhile, the top-line saw a $900 million unfavorable impact from Y/Y changes in foreign exchange rates.
Turning to guidance for Q4, Amazon sees revenue of $240 billion to $247 billion. The consensus estimate had been for revenue of $244.30 billion. AMZN also kept its full-year 2026 capital expenditures forecast unchanged at about $220 billion.
(Anuron Mitra contributed to this report.)

title: Reddit shares plunge 23% on DAUs deceleration, weak guidance
full_text:
Investing.com -- Reddit reported third-quarter results that topped analyst estimates, but shares sank sharply after the social media company issued a weaker-than-expected revenue outlook and warned of accelerating declines in search referral traffic.
The stock is down about 22% shortly after the open on Friday.
Reddit reported adjusted earnings of $1.40 per share, beating the consensus estimate of $1.33. Revenue rose 53% year over year to $895 million, above expectations of $874.9 million.
However, the company forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $1.00 billion to $1.03 billion, putting the midpoint of $1.015 billion below Wall Street’s $1.05 billion estimate.
The outlook comes as Reddit faces mounting pressure from changes in how users discover content online. Search referral traffic declined meaningfully in the third quarter, with the downturn accelerating toward the end of the period, CEO Steve Huffman said in a shareholder letter.
In October, search traffic fell by more than 1 million referrals per week on average. If the trend continues, Reddit warned that daily active unique users (DAUs) could decline by a low-double-digit percentage in the fourth quarter from its current base of 130.3 million.
Reddit’s DAUs grew 12% in the third quarter, a 6 percentage point slowdown from the previous quarter. The shortfall came mainly from U.S. logged-out users as Google’s AI Overviews cut referral traffic from one of Reddit’s largest user acquisition channels.
"RDDT’s delivery of strong Revenue/EBITDA growth (53%/70%) was overshadowed by worsening U.S. DAU declines, as increased prevalence of AI Overview negatively impacted referral traffic," Jefferies analyst John Colantuoni said.
"Growth is also expected to slow in 4Q, which is likely to raise concern about sustainability. We think the stock could be rangebound near-term until a recovery in user trends emerges, but still like the long-term story as monetization upside helps drive peer-leading revenue growth," he added.
Weekly active uniques grew 16% to 515.2 million.
KeyBanc Capital Markets downgraded Reddit after the earnings release. “We are downgrading shares of RDDT from OW to SW as our thesis is not playing out; search traffic is a larger headwind than envisioned (potential for a LDD% q/q decline in 4Q), and this creates more uncertainty around ’27E/’28E revenue and EBITDA," they wrote.
Separately, Citizens also cut the stock to Market Perform from Outperform, citing the sequential deceleration in U.S. DAUs. "Reddit will begin testing a logged in user experience as it expects to receive increasingly less traffic from Google, which is a headwind for top-of-funnel and reengaging users."
Reddit CEO Huffman said the company was focusing on growing its logged-in and app audiences, which account for more than 80% of Reddit’s monetization. Reddit plans to improve user retention, expand app adoption and begin testing a primarily logged-in experience in select markets outside the U.S. in the fourth quarter.
"Our business is growing because the Reddit experience captures the human experience in a way that no other platform can replicate," Huffman said. He added that surpassing $3 billion in revenue over the past 12 months demonstrated the strength of Reddit as a destination and the differentiated value of its platform.
Advertising remained a key growth driver during the quarter, with revenue increasing 54% year over year to $847 million. Net income rose 74% to $283 million, equivalent to a 32% net margin, while adjusted EBITDA climbed 70% to $402 million, representing a 45% margin.
Reddit forecast fourth-quarter adjusted EBITDA of $480 million to $510 million. The company also repurchased approximately 670,000 shares for $100 million during the third quarter.
Vahid Karaahmetovic contributed to this report.

title: Oil hits six-month highs as Hormuz attacks threaten Iran peace efforts
full_text:
Investing.com -- Oil prices ended October at six-month highs as attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz intensified, complicating diplomatic efforts to end the U.S.-Israel war with Iran.
Brent crude futures settled Friday at $117.64 a barrel, up 2.4%, after touching $118. U.S. West Texas Intermediate rose 2.1% to $104.12. Brent gained 13.6% in October and WTI climbed 15.2%.
Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said four oil tankers caught fire following incidents in or near Hormuz on Friday, including vessels it said struck naval mines after entering unauthorized routes. The claims could not be independently verified.
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency separately reported a projectile striking a tanker leaving the strait and another vessel catching fire after a strike south of Iran’s Lavan Island. The latter crew was reported safe.
A tally of UKMTO reports showed at least 35 attacks on shipping in the Gulf and Hormuz during October, the highest monthly count since the conflict began in February.
Shipping traffic has improved but remains sharply depressed. UKMTO recorded 122 outbound and 155 inbound transits in the week through October 28, roughly 70% below pre-war levels.
President Donald Trump said Friday that talks with Iran were continuing and later suggested the war would end soon, insisting Tehran must never obtain a nuclear weapon.
Qatari mediators returned to Tehran on Friday following reports that Vice President JD Vance had proposed renewed talks. Iranian sources said a meeting could take place within a week in Doha or Istanbul.
Pakistan’s military also expressed cautious optimism about its mediation efforts.
Yet reports that U.S. military officials briefed Trump on options for additional strikes, potentially after Tuesday’s midterm elections, highlighted the risk of renewed fighting. An Iranian official warned Tehran had prepared a broad response to any new attack.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said the conflict had added more than €100 billion ($112 billion) to Europe’s energy costs and urged a negotiated settlement.
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi responded with a warning of severe retaliation against countries attacking Iran, keeping the possibility of further disruption to energy shipments in focus.

title: Bitcoin holds above $77,000 as Binance hack recovery takes shape
full_text:
Investing.com -- Bitcoin traded slightly above $77,000 on Saturday as investors assessed fresh developments in the record $6.3 billion Binance hack, with Wall Street analysts suggesting the cryptocurrency’s recent selloff may have created buying opportunities.
The world’s largest cryptocurrency was trading down 1.71% at $77,175.4 as of 01:34 ET (05:34 GMT) after the security breach rattled digital asset markets late Thursday, triggering sharp declines in cryptocurrency-linked stocks.
Attention has shifted from the initial theft to the attackers’ efforts to move stolen funds and the industry’s ability to contain the damage.
Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis identified previously unseen laundering patterns involving thousands of transactions, suggesting hackers deployed automated systems to conceal stolen assets.
Investigators linked the activity to Tradertraitor, a North Korean hacking group, after identifying connections between the stolen Binance assets and funds taken during September’s Bitget breach.
The attackers also converted $325 million in stablecoins into approximately $285 million in ether, apparently seeking to move funds beyond the reach of issuer-controlled freezes.
Binance, meanwhile, outlined plans to restore withdrawals in phases following security checks and said it had reserved more than $6.34 billion in company funds to cover losses.
The exchange also plans to publish proof-of-reserves data by Monday, November 2, providing investors with another measure of its financial position.
Despite the disruption, analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point argued that the breach does not necessarily threaten Bitcoin’s underlying technology or the broader market’s recovery.
Cantor analyst Ramsey El-Assal viewed weakness in cryptocurrency-linked equities as a potential buying opportunity.
Compass Point identified the $75,000 to $77,000 range as an important support area for Bitcoin, warning that a sustained break below those levels could threaten its recent recovery.
Separately, Tether reported $1.5 billion in third-quarter operating profit, bringing its nine-month total to $4.5 billion.
The stablecoin issuer’s reserves reached $191.5 billion, exceeding liabilities by nearly $8 billion.
The figures provided another indication of the financial resources available within the stablecoin sector as issuers face renewed scrutiny over their ability to freeze stolen assets.
Legal experts cautioned that freezing tokens does not automatically establish ownership or guarantee their recovery, leaving the outcome of the Binance investigation uncertain.

World No. 2 cryptocurrency Ether edged up 0.02% to $2,240.54.

Solana declined 1.98% to $96.08, while BNB fell 1.91% to $702.57.
Cardano retreated 0.26% to $0.1929, while Dogecoin lost 1.16%.
Among meme coins, TRUMP fell 2.21%, while Shiba Inu rose 0.85%.

title: Agentic AI excitement runs ahead of results
full_text:
Investing.com -- Investor enthusiasm for agentic artificial intelligence is growing faster than the technology’s ability to generate meaningful revenue and productivity gains, according to a report from BCA Research.
In an October 23 report, BCA Research chief technology and innovation strategist Matt Dyson warned that sustaining positive sentiment through 2027 would require stronger AI revenues or a breakthrough application, such as capable personal assistants.
The firm highlighted a persistent gap between AI adoption and measurable financial returns.
A 2025 MIT study suggested that 95% of corporate AI pilots failed to achieve deployment with positive returns within six months. A 2026 McKinsey survey found that just 6% of respondents attributed at least 5% of operating earnings to AI adoption.
BCA estimated that AI systems with human oversight could perform certain tasks at approximately 75% lower cost than U.S. employees.
Yet those savings often overlook what the firm calls the "AI validation tax," referring to the additional time employees spend checking AI-generated work.
The report also questioned whether surging AI token consumption accurately reflects productive usage.
More sophisticated reasoning models consume four to 15 times as many tokens, helping explain rapid demand growth without a corresponding increase in useful output.
Agentic AI has also raised concerns about traditional software companies.
The launch of Anthropic’s Claude Cowork plugins contributed to a 15% decline in the MSCI U.S. IT Services index in January, affecting companies including Salesforce, Intuit and Workday.
BCA described the market reaction as excessive, arguing that smaller businesses would likely continue favoring established software platforms.
The firm expects companies to need at least a year to restructure workflows around AI capabilities.
Dyson also warned that only 20% of freelance tasks completed by leading AI models currently meet reasonable client acceptance standards, highlighting the gap between technical performance and commercial usefulness.

title: Russia says Ukraine peace stance unchanged as Lavrov criticizes Zelenskiy
full_text:
Investing.com -- Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said Friday that Moscow’s position on the Ukraine war remains unchanged, warning that President Volodymyr Zelenskiy’s continued support for strikes on Russian targets could complicate efforts to restart peace negotiations.
Speaking on the sidelines of a G20 foreign ministers’ meeting in Atlanta, Lavrov questioned Ukraine’s intentions ahead of potential trilateral negotiations involving Russia, Ukraine and the U.S.
He said Zelenskiy’s repeated statements about acquiring additional weapons to strike Russian targets were making preparations for fresh negotiations more difficult.
Both Moscow and Kyiv have expressed willingness to resume three-way discussions for the first time since early 2026.
Zelenskiy said this week that he hoped negotiators would meet in Abu Dhabi between November 6 and 10, adding that Ukraine wanted European representatives involved in discussions on ending the conflict.
Lavrov reiterated Moscow’s longstanding position that Ukraine must not pose a military threat to Russia’s security interests.
The Russian foreign minister also criticized Washington’s continued military assistance to Kyiv, arguing that fundamental disagreements between Moscow and the U.S. remained unresolved.
He pointed to ongoing sanctions against Russia and increased U.S. intelligence cooperation with Ukraine.
Lavrov specifically cited Friday’s U.S. State Department approval of a proposed sale of 500 Patriot PAC-3 missiles to Ukraine as evidence that Washington’s military support was continuing.
Separately, Lavrov criticized the U.S. decision to invite Poland to the G20 gathering, arguing that the move violated diplomatic practices requiring consensus among member countries.
Polish Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski said Washington had proposed making Poland a permanent G20 member, an initiative Warsaw was actively pursuing.
Lavrov dismissed Poland’s participation, arguing that existing NATO and European Union members already provided sufficient regional representation.
Sikorski also called for an immediate ceasefire in the Black Sea to permit safe grain shipments from both Ukraine and Russia.
The meeting’s proceedings showed the diplomatic disagreements, as foreign ministers skipped the traditional group photo after some participants objected to appearing alongside Lavrov.

title: What comes next for EU-China trade?
full_text:
Investing.com -- Trade tensions between the European Union and China could intensify in 2027 as Brussels considers additional measures to address its widening trade deficit with Beijing, although a full-scale trade war remains unlikely, according to Citi analysts.
In a research note, Citi said the recent EU-China agreement to restrict Chinese hybrid-vehicle exports could provide a foundation for broader negotiations, but warned that further trade restrictions remained possible.
The agreement comes as Europe’s trade deficit with China exceeds €1 billion per day, prompting European officials to consider stronger measures to rebalance bilateral trade.
China’s trade surplus with the EU reached $291.7 billion in 2025, an increase of 18.1% from the previous year and more than double the $113.8 billion recorded in 2019.
Chinese exports to the bloc rose 8.4% in 2025, while imports from Europe declined 0.4%, widening the imbalance.
The trend accelerated during the first nine months of 2026, with China’s trade surplus with the EU increasing 26% from a year earlier.
China’s share of total EU imports also climbed to 22.4% in 2025, even as Europe’s share of Chinese imports continued to decline.
Citi expects Brussels could introduce further trade measures targeting Chinese goods, potentially increasing friction between the two economies.
Beijing may respond by offering practical concessions, including commitments to increase imports, agreements covering specific industries and reductions in value-added tax export rebates.
The analysts believe the prospect of substantial economic damage on both sides should discourage an escalation comparable to the 2025 U.S.-China trade confrontation.
Still, prolonged uncertainty over trade policy could weigh on economic growth in 2027.
For China, the risks are particularly significant as policymakers face increasing pressure to maintain annual economic growth near 4%.
The bank expects trade-related uncertainty to remain a significant challenge for Chinese exports and the broader economy next year.

title: Is the market too bearish on aluminium?
full_text:
Investing.com -- Investor sentiment toward aluminium has turned excessively bearish despite resilient demand and historically low inventories, according to analysts who expect prices to rise to $3,625 per tonne in 2027.
The analysts said discussions with market participants pointed to unusually negative sentiment, but argued that aluminium’s underlying supply-demand fundamentals supported a more constructive outlook.
Their assessment followed Norsk Hydro’s (OSL) third-quarter results, which showed stronger year-on-year earnings but fell short of market expectations.
The Norwegian aluminium producer reported EBITDA of NOK 9.1 billion, up 52% from a year earlier and 2% sequentially, but 6% below consensus estimates.
Higher aluminium prices supported earnings, although rising costs and foreign exchange movements weighed on profitability.
Performance varied across divisions, with Bauxite and Alumina exceeding reduced expectations and Extrusions outperforming forecasts. Primary Metal, Markets and Energy delivered weaker results.
The analysts lowered their 2026 EBITDA forecast by 4% to NOK 34.9 billion and reduced their price target to NOK 92 from NOK 98, maintaining a Buy rating.
Hydro also lowered its capital expenditure guidance to NOK 12.5 billion from NOK 13.5 billion.
Operational disruptions remained a concern after a temporary natural gas supply interruption affected the Alunorte alumina refinery.
Production has returned to normal following alternative LNG arrangements, although elevated energy costs are expected to persist into the fourth quarter.
Meanwhile, Hydro has begun restarting its Slovalco smelter in Slovakia, targeting annual production capacity of 75,000 tonnes by February 2027.
The company’s downstream Extrusions business also showed signs of recovery following an extended downturn.
Improving recycling margins, better cost performance and stabilising market conditions supported the division’s third-quarter performance.
The analysts expect higher volumes and steadier margins ahead, reinforcing their view that aluminium market pessimism may be overstated.
